Context: 10. Instructions/ Guidelines relating to filling up the integrity column of Annual Performance Assessment Reports

- (e) In all cases, where a Reporting Officer cannot in fairness to himself and to the officer reported upon, either certify integrity or make an adverse entry, the Reporting Officer should make an entry in the integrity column to the effect that he has not watched the officer's work for sufficient time to be able to make any definite remark or that he has heard nothing against the officer's integrity, as the case may be.
